column3: The model picker's search asks the server (`models.list { query }`), not the 40-row page
column4: the catalog holds about 1,592 models and the op caps a reply at 40, so an in-menu filter could only ever search the visible page and every model past it was unreachable
column5: while it was a client filter, typing "haiku" returned "No model matches that" once the first page did not contain one; now typing "haiku" lists every Haiku row from opencode and the unkeyed providers, with `$` marks and `no key` on the greyed ones
column6: P17-model-search-1440.png; the screen calls `searchModels` in state/settings.ts and passes `query` to the op
